The query-map benchmark honestly reports a NEGATIVE counter-authority yield (0 candidates for 2/4 frozen questions). Later milestones (answer generation, UX, LABEL_SOUND/GEOMETRY_SOUND) are correctly marked incomplete (human_gate_ready=false, machine_gate_ready=false, packet_admitted=false).
